learnings: Transient API errors on trivial files (like .gitignore) can cause an entire package audit to be marked inconclusive. The audit tool could implement automatic retries for failed LLM API calls or exclude trivial non-executable files like .gitignore from causing a hard inconclusive block if they fail.
